title: Move Workspaces into the control-panel rail above Projects
outcome: Direct Greg request in session-4982 with screenshots: treat workspaces like other sections, immediately above Projects; Codex designs and breaks down work, Termal::Grok implements. DESIGN: replace the large pane-bar Workspace popover with a normal Workspaces control-panel section. Use an outlined layout/windows icon, standard active indicator, tooltip and keyboard behavior. Default and first migration place Workspaces directly before Projects; preserve all existing user order and honor subsequent manual reorder. Normal panel header Workspaces, New workspace here (+), New window secondary action, Refresh; searchable compact list, current row first, remaining rows label/id alphabetical with id tiebreaker, Current badge. Main row shows label or short-id fallback, optional muted updated time; full UUID in accessible details/tooltip, never a dominant wide chip. Row main button switches here; separate overflow actions Rename, Open in new tab, Delete; preserve no open-new-tab/delete for current workspace and existing 80-char/empty-label rules, add explicit confirmation for delete, preserve failures inline. Existing backend/API/URL/storage/last-write-wins semantics do not change. Reuse app-workspace-layout handlers; no layout save/recovery rewrite. Scope v1: full dock section and rail reorder, not a new persisted workspace-list tab kind or drag-out launcher. Remove old popover only once access via the normal control panel remains available when dock is closed or moved. Tests cover old-order migration, CRUD/switch/new-tab safeguards, stale async results, keyboard/focus, narrow dock/long labels and left/right docking. No implementation by Codex in this planning handoff. Grok owns source changes, focused tests and docs; Codex owns final full gates and required Codex+Claude review. No commit/push/deploy/Beads close without further Greg instruction.
